propositions: Retire phantom SYNC-dependent output cells (orphaned, duplicates, stale) that short-circuit on missing SYNC events and never populate.
Add store_integrity as an offline alerting cell that validates forward/reverse binding agreement with six specific finding kinds and fails closed on inconsistency.
Detect unknown_event_types from committed tickets ref using ref-based git grep and git show without requiring a checkout, treating exit 1 as clean and exit >=2 as RebarError(returncode=2).
Remove SYNC-only scan arms and stale-timestamp infrastructure (_STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _to_ns, --now-ts) while preserving BRIDGE_ALERT event paths and bridge-status compatibility.
Preserve informational exit semantics: unknown_event_types and binding_drift remain non-gating; store_integrity findings gate with exit 1; operational failures use exit 2.
